verdict.rationale: PayPal Subscriptions documents a first-party capability to "Automate payment recovery for failed payments" as part of subscription plans, which covers the automatic-retry core of the story. Nothing in the evidence describes retry scheduling, smart dunning logic, or subscriber recovery emails; the automatic payment reminders that are documented belong to Invoicing, not subscriptions. Missing for 10: details of retry schedule and configuration, smart dunning logic, subscription recovery/dunning emails, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can automatically retry failed subscription payments with smart dunning and recovery emails

citations.quote: Automate payment recovery for failed payments.
Create customizable PayPal subscription plans for regular billing, offering trials, upgrades, and automated payment recovery for flexible customer management.
